meta.name: baoyu-post-to-weibo
meta.description: Posts content to Weibo (微博). Supports regular posts with text, images, and videos, and headline articles (头条文章) with Markdown input via Chrome CDP. Use when user asks to "post to Weibo", "发微博", "发布微博", "publish to Weibo", "share on Weibo", "写微博", or "微博头条文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到微博
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或批量发布微博内容
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or batch post to Weibo

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过真实 Chrome 填写微博:普通微博支持文字/图片/视频(最多 18 个);头条文章可把 Markdown 变成带标题、导语和图片的草稿。只填不发布,由你手动确认;首次使用需手动登录微博。
howto.when: 当用户说“发微博”、“发布微博头条文章”等指令,或表达“share on Weibo”时触发;若给出 .md 文件且未指定类型,默认作成头条文章。

say.text: 把这句话发成微博:今天天气不错
say.note: 真实 Chrome 打开发布框,内容已填好

say.text: 把 report.md 发成头条文章,封面用 cover.jpg
say.note: 自动填标题导语、插图,完成后提醒检查

say.text: 把这个视频 clip.mp4 发成微博
say.note: 视频会填进草稿,由你确认后发布

howto.what_en: Claude uses real Chrome to fill Weibo drafts: regular posts support text/images/videos (up to 18 files); headline articles turn Markdown into drafts with title, summary, and images. Scripts only fill and check content; you publish manually. First run: log in to Weibo manually.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to '发微博', '发布微博头条文章', or 'share on Weibo'; .md files default to a headline article unless a type is specified.

say_en.text: Post this to Weibo: the weather is nice today.
say_en.note: Opens real Chrome with content filled in for you to publish.

say_en.text: Publish report.md as a Weibo headline article with cover.jpg
say_en.note: Fills title, summary, and images, then checks the draft.

say_en.text: Share clip.mp4 as a video post on Weibo
say_en.note: Video is placed in the draft; you confirm and post.
